brbe.gui.tip.1: You can right-click the search bar to clear its text.
brbe.gui.tip.2: Press A (default) to pin the recipe under your cursor to the front page.
brbe.gui.tip.3: Incomplete recipes are those that have some materials in your inventory but cannot be crafted. Inspired by Bedrock Edition.
brbe.gui.tip.4: Using it with an item manager is also great — you can look up how to craft recipes and their uses in the recipe book (hotkeys follow your item manager). You can also hide the item manager's interface in "UI".
brbe.gui.tip.5: The creative mode tab feature comes from the Recipe Book is Pain mod!
brbe.gui.tip.6: Come say hi on social media and make some friends!
brbe.gui.tip.7: All code is generated by DeepSeek!
brbe.gui.tip.8: Hold Ctrl and click a page-turn button in the recipe area to jump straight to the first or last page.
brbe.gui.tip.9: To jump to a specific page in the recipe area: type "……" in the search bar, then the page number, then "……" again. ("……" can be replaced with "^")
